mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, task_id, template_code, recipient_id, channel, priority, rendered_title, rendered_body, related_type, related_id, link, status, retry_count, error_reason, sent_at, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_message_task WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY created_at, id
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_message_task SET status = 'SENT', retry_count = #{retryCount}, sent_at = #{sentAt}, error_reason = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sys_message_task SET status = 'FAILED''PENDING', retry_count = #{retryCount}, error_reason = #{errorReason}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sys_message_task SET status = 'SKIPPED', error_reason = #{errorReason}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
